tools.name: teams_post_adaptive_card
tools.description: Post an Adaptive Card (risk briefing, alert, or shift handover summary) to a specific Microsoft Teams channel, optionally including structured action buttons (e.g., Create Work Order, Dismiss). This is a write action limited to channels the bot has been explicitly installed on; it does not itself change any system of record.

correlation_id.description: conversationId correlated to the source event (alarm ID, notification number).

tools.name: teams_send_direct_message
tools.description: Send a 1:1 direct message escalation to an on-call technician or shift supervisor. Write action limited to onboarded users; used for critical breakdown escalation.

user_upn.description: User principal name / email of the recipient.

tools.name: teams_get_card_action_responses
tools.description: Retrieve button-click / adaptive card action responses (e.g., Approve, Escalate, Acknowledge) received for a given correlation ID, so the orchestration layer can route the human decision back into the workflow.
